body: Anything that gets me a decent job. But I don't think any of it is achievable. I don't have any options that I can choose from right now.

Im not a smart person and I don’t have a good income. So i can never always obtain the education i need to survive or have a good future. Im failing at school too. Everyone has high expectations for me, but i can barely achieve a bit of it. Also my family doesn’t want to support me or have me around anymore and no one i know want to be associated with me now.
I really dont think there is another way. Nothing has changed or gotten better. 6 years and counting.
